description: List initiatives with status, progress and token budget/spend. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor`, `appliedFilters` (the filters that actually ran — check it when the page surprises you) and `nextAction`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the SAME filters to get the next page. A page with no relevant rows says nothing about the remaining pages — check `meta.hasMore` before concluding there is no match. Narrow with `programId`, `status` (comma-separated), `priority`, `owner`, `tag` or `search` rather than paging through a whole workspace; this is the tool that scopes a question before anyforge_list_work_items reads the items under one initiative. `search` matches code, name, description, repo and tags only. Archived initiatives are hidden unless includeArchived is set. Rows are the list projection (description is excerpted, dollar spend is omitted) — call anyforge_get_initiative for the full record.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with identical filters.

owner.description: Filter by DRI uid; "me" for the API key owner, "__unassigned__" for initiatives with no DRI.

programId.description: Only initiatives in this program. Pass "__none__" for the unlinked ones.

search.description: Match against code, name, description, repo and tags.

sort.description: Page order (default "updated", newest first). "progress" is ranked in memory over a bounded scan, so on a very large workspace it sets `meta.truncated` — say so rather than reporting the ranking as complete.

tag.description: Match initiatives carrying ANY of these tags.

name: anyforge_list_initiatives
title: List initiatives
